title: JKSSB Jobs 2026 - Apply Online for 357 Draftsman and Work Supervisor Posts
description: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has released the official notification for 2026. Allotted 357 vacancies for Draftsman and Work Supervisor Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the Diploma in Civil Engineering, 10th Pass, or ITI can grab this chance and apply for the JKSSB Jobs 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply...
